question: The average of 9 consecutive natural numbers is 22. If the next 3 consecutive natural numbers are also included, what is the new average?
solution: The smallest number is 22 − 4 = 18. Now there are 12 evenly spaced numbers from it, so the middle moves up by 3 × 1 ÷ 2 = 1.5: new average = 22 + 1.5 = 23.5.
questionHi: 9 क्रमागत प्राकृत संख्याओं का औसत 22 है। यदि अगली 3 क्रमागत प्राकृत संख्याएँ भी शामिल कर ली जाएँ, तो नया औसत क्या होगा?
solutionHi: सबसे छोटी संख्या 22 − 4 = 18 है। अब उससे शुरू होकर 12 समान अंतर वाली संख्याएँ हैं, अतः बीच का मान 3 × 1 ÷ 2 = 1.5 बढ़ जाता है: नया औसत = 22 + 1.5 = 23.5।

question: The average of 5 consecutive even numbers is 18. What is the sum of the smallest and the largest of them?

solution: The first multiple of 12 in the range is 60 and the last is 168 (10 numbers, evenly spaced). Average = (60 + 168) ÷ 2 = 114.

solution: The average of evenly spaced numbers is the middle value, so the smallest is 61 − 7 = 54 and the largest is 61 + 7 = 68. Sum = 54 + 68 = 122.
questionHi: 8 क्रमागत सम संख्याओं का औसत 61 है। इनमें सबसे छोटी और सबसे बड़ी संख्या का योग क्या है?
solutionHi: समान अंतर वाली संख्याओं का औसत बीच का मान होता है, अतः सबसे छोटी 61 − 7 = 54 और सबसे बड़ी 61 + 7 = 68 है। योग = 54 + 68 = 122।

question: What is the average of all the numbers from 44 to 109 that are divisible by 7?
solution: The first multiple of 7 in the range is 49 and the last is 105 (9 numbers, evenly spaced). Average = (49 + 105) ÷ 2 = 77.
questionHi: 44 से 109 तक की उन सभी संख्याओं का औसत क्या है जो 7 से विभाज्य हैं?
solutionHi: इस सीमा में 7 का पहला गुणज 49 और अंतिम 105 है (9 संख्याएँ, समान अंतर पर)। औसत = (49 + 105) ÷ 2 = 77।

question: The average of 8 numbers is 25. If one of the numbers is left out, the average of the rest becomes 13. Which number was left out?
solution: Sum of 8 = 8 × 25 = 200. Sum of the other 7 = 7 × 13 = 91. Left out = 200 − 91 = 109.

question: At the time of their marriage 3 years ago, the average age of a husband and wife was 25 years. Today they have a child aged 1 year. What is the average age of the family now?
solution: The couple now: 2 × (25 + 3) = 56 years in all. With the child: 56 + 1 = 57 for 3 people. Average = 57 ÷ 3 = 19 years.

question: The average of 10 consecutive odd numbers is 20. What is the sum of the smallest and the largest of them?
solution: The average of evenly spaced numbers is the middle value, so the smallest is 20 − 9 = 11 and the largest is 20 + 9 = 29. Sum = 11 + 29 = 40.
questionHi: 10 क्रमागत विषम संख्याओं का औसत 20 है। इनमें सबसे छोटी और सबसे बड़ी संख्या का योग क्या है?
solutionHi: समान अंतर वाली संख्याओं का औसत बीच का मान होता है, अतः सबसे छोटी 20 − 9 = 11 और सबसे बड़ी 20 + 9 = 29 है। योग = 11 + 29 = 40।

question: The average of 12 numbers is 20. The average of 4 of them is 15 and the average of another 5 of them is 21. What is the average of the remaining numbers?
solution: Sum of all = 12 × 20 = 240. The two groups add up to 4 × 15 + 5 × 21 = 165. The other 3 add up to 75, so their average = 75 ÷ 3 = 25.

question: The average age of 24 students is 14 years. The average age of 6 of them is 11 years and that of another 5 is 15 years. What is the average age of the remaining students?
solution: Total = 24 × 14 = 336. The two groups: 6 × 11 + 5 × 15 = 141. The other 13 total 195, average 195 ÷ 13 = 15 years.

question: In a class, the average mark of the boys is 57, that of the girls is 82, and that of the whole class is 79. What percentage of the class are boys?
solution: Boys are 22 below the class average and girls 3 above it, so boys : girls = 3 : 22. Boys = 3 ÷ 25 × 100 = 12%.
questionHi: एक कक्षा में लड़कों के औसत अंक 57, लड़कियों के 82 और पूरी कक्षा के 79 हैं। कक्षा में लड़के कितने प्रतिशत हैं?
solutionHi: लड़के कक्षा के औसत से 22 नीचे और लड़कियाँ 3 ऊपर हैं, अतः लड़के : लड़कियाँ = 3 : 22। लड़के = 3 ÷ 25 × 100 = 12%।
